claim_ceiling: finite-support diagnostic on the CUT LATTICE (bipartition lattice) of n-qubit pure states (manifold-tower L8/L9/L10 candidate). The GENUINE load-bearing content is the set of per-cut entanglement DISCRIMINATORS that COULD have come out otherwise: (1) a product state has S_A=0 / Schmidt rank 1 on EVERY cut; (2) GHZ and W states yield DIFFERENT per-cut entropy PROFILES (CKW/monogamy spread) -- not a by-construction identity; (3) a maximally-entangled cut reaches S_A=log2(dim_A); (4) a product state has zero negativity on every cut while an entangled state does not; (5) a deterministic scramble unitary moves entropy off the product baseline. Cross-engine AGREEMENT (exact/jax/pytorch/julia, 1e-9) on the entropy + Schmidt-rank invariants is the four-language witness. NO M(C) admission, NO Axis0 closure, NO QIT engine, NO smooth manifold, NO physics. Per-cut entropy reductions of |psi><psi| are well-defined linear algebra; what is load-bearing is the STATE-DEPENDENT divergence, not the formula.
box_viii_status: OPEN -- a single fresh-context pipeline is insufficient; requires a MULTI-MODEL FLEET audit before any promotion claim. Builder verdict on its own work is never evidence.
source_target: manifold-tower L8/L9/L10 cut-lattice + Schmidt strata + per-cut entropy layer; bipartition lattice of an n-qubit pure state, reduced density matrices, von Neumann entanglement entropy, mutual information, conditional/coherent information (3q+), CKW monogamy spread between GHZ and W classes

object_under_test.support: finite. For n in {2,3,4}: the CUT LATTICE = the 2^{n-1}-1 bipartitions (A,B) of the qubit register, enumerated as subsets A with qubit 0 in A and A != full register (anchoring to qubit 0 removes the A<->B double count). Per cut the carrier is rho_A = Tr_B |psi><psi|.

n3: bell pair on the two HIGH-ORDER axes (tensor axes 0 and 1, = bit positions n-1 and n-2) tensored with |0> on the low-order axis: (|000>+|110>)/sqrt2 in the reshape([2]*n) MSB-first convention -- NOT a Bell pair on code-qubits 0,1 as a left-to-right reading would suggest

per_cut_quantities: schmidt_rank: number of nonzero eigenvalues of rho_A per cut. Computed per cut internally; the EXPORTED cross-engine invariants are the aggregates schmidt_rank_product (max over product-state cuts) and n4_max_cut_rank (max over the max-entangled state's cuts) -- a full per-cut rank TUPLE is NOT exported (it is not a state discriminator anyway: pure-state rank_A==rank_B, and GHZ/W share identical n=4 rank tuples; entropy is the GHZ/W discriminator, not rank).
S_A = -sum_i lambda_i log2 lambda_i (von Neumann entanglement entropy); S_A == S_B by global purity (Schmidt symmetry -- a by-construction identity, reported NOT gated)
mutual_information I(A:B) = S_A + S_B - S_AB = 2 S_A for a globally pure state (by-construction identity)
coherent_information I_c(A>B) = S_B - S_AB = S_A for a globally pure state (by-construction identity, 3q+ reported)
negativity N(A) = sum of |negative eigenvalues| of the partial transpose rho^{T_A}

subsystem-orientation marginal: on the W4 single-qubit cut (|A|=1, |B|=3), rho_A must be 2x2 (a rho_B swap returns 8x8) and its |1> diagonal must equal the axis-0 single-qubit marginal 0.25 computed independently from |psi|^2 -- a load-bearing check that catches an A<->B partial-trace swap the entropy/rank spectra cannot see

hypotheses_under_test: H_product_zero: a fully separable product state has S_A=0 and Schmidt rank 1 on EVERY cut, and zero negativity on every cut (could fail: a buggy reduction or a non-product state breaks it).

H_ghz_w_divergence: GHZ and W of the same n have DIFFERENT per-cut entropy profiles. n=3: GHZ S=1.0 on every cut, W S=log2(3)-2/3 ~ 0.918296 on every cut (uniform but lower). n=4: GHZ S=1.0 on every cut (flat); W single-qubit cuts S~0.811278, balanced 2:2 cut S=1.0 (NON-flat). The GHZ-W max per-cut entropy gap is nonzero. This is a genuine CKW/monogamy discriminator, not an identity.
H_max_entangled_cut: a maximally entangled 2:2 cut reaches S_A=log2(dim_A)=2.0 with Schmidt rank = dim_A = 4 (the algebraic ceiling for that cut).

H_purity_symmetry: S_A == S_B across every cut for a globally pure state (Schmidt symmetry). BY-CONSTRUCTION identity -- holds for ANY correct pure-state reduction, cannot fail; reported as a consistency check, does NOT gate all_tests_pass or agreement_ok.

H_mutual_coherent: for a globally pure state I(A:B)=2 S_A and I_c(A>B)=S_A on every cut. BY-CONSTRUCTION identities (S_AB=0 reduces both to S_A==S_B); reported as consistency, NOT load-bearing, do NOT gate.

H_subsystem_orientation: on the W4 single-qubit cut, the reduction returns rho_A (not rho_B) -- pinned by matching rho_A's 2x2 shape and its |1> diagonal to the independently-computed asymmetric axis-0 marginal (0.25). LOAD-BEARING: catches an A<->B partial-trace swap that the entropy/rank spectra are blind to (pure-state S_A==S_B, rank_A==rank_B). Gates all_tests_pass and agreement_ok.
controls_that_must_fire: product_negativity_zero: every cut of every product state has negativity ~ 0 AND S_A ~ 0 AND rank 1
entangled_vs_separable_divergence: for at least one cut, the entangled state's S_A exceeds the product state's S_A by > 0.5 (real separation)
ghz_vs_w_profile_divergence: max over cuts of |S_A^GHZ - S_A^W| > 0.05 (n=3) and the W n=4 profile is NON-uniform while GHZ is uniform
bell_pair_cut_dependence: bell_01 x |0>_2 gives S=1 on the {0}|{1,2} cut but S=0 on the {0,1}|{2} cut (entropy depends on WHICH cut, not by-construction constant)
scramble_moves_entropy: a deterministic scramble unitary takes the product baseline S=0 on the {0} cut to S > 0.1
max_cut_hits_ceiling: the maximally entangled 2:2 cut reaches S_A = log2(4) = 2.0 to 1e-9
